item.title: GeoCam vs IFTTT for Blink Geofencing
item.description: IFTTT is the most common way people try to make Blink follow their location, and for good reason: it has a Blink service, and the two location applets “arm Blink when I leave” and “disarm Blink when I arrive” are among its most used Blink recipes. For one person living alone it can be enough. The limits show up as soon as there is a second person in the house, or you want more than “the whole system on or off”.
